messages:
Eva: Heads-up — noticed a small but persistent bump in provisional credits for some streaming sessions after fallback. Sample customer acct_42. Investigating.
ops-bot: :rotating_light: Billing alert: provisional_credit_spike > 5% in us-west for model-x-small at 2026-03-10T14:05Z — https://console/redwood/alerts/8921
Ravi: Can you paste a session_id or a snippet of logs? Thinking leftover prefix tokens after a downgrade.
Eva: session 8a3f9c2e — logs look like this (trimmed):
```
[2026-03-10T14:04:58Z] session=8a3f9c2e route=model-A prefix_size=120 provisional=true
[2026-03-10T14:05:00Z] session=8a3f9c2e fallback=route->model-B
[2026-03-10T14:05:58Z] ledger.emit provisional_credit +120 acct=acct_42
```
Jordan: If provisional credits are only tombstoned by TTL we’d see exactly that. Why aren’t we finalizing on successful handoff? Seems like we could avoid the 60s window.
Ravi: There’s a safety tradeoff: if you tombstone on handoff but the client later reconnects and resumes on the original shard, we might undercount. Need an idempotent approach.
Lina: Could we send a finalize_prefix event when downstream gives an ACK that it accepted the handoff? CC @Sam for console telemetry needs.
Sam: Console UX ask: show provisional vs finalized token counts per session timeline so support can explain phantom charges. But backend events are required first.
Eva: Proposed change: on fallback-success (ACK from the target runtime), emit finalize_prefix(session_id, last_offset, tombstone_token). Ledger applies immediate decrement. Tombstone must be idempotent. Race cases?
Ravi: Implement tombstone as idempotent operation: tombstone(token, offset) that only reduces provisional if offset <= recorded_unfinalized_offset. Also record tombstone_tx_id to dedupe retries. Add reconciliation job that scans mismatches and emits corrective ledger ops.
Jordan: Also add metrics: prefix_tombstone_latency, provisional_delta_on_handoff, tombstone_dedupe_rate. Will help validate rollout.
Sam: I'll prototype a console panel: session timeline with events (route, fallback, finalize_prefix, ledger delta). Low risk; hides the TTL noise.
Eva: OK I'll write a short RFC + spike to emit finalize_prefix in the fallback path. I'll instrument logs and metrics and wire a reconcile run for 24/7 for a week after rollout. Anyone object?
Lina: :thumbsup: no objections. Add nightly reconcile for the first 7 days and a guardrail to revert if provisional_deltas increase.
Ravi: One more: ensure handoff ack is only from the runtime that will serve tokens (i.e., not from a proxy). Confirm semantics before we finalize in ledger.
Eva: Good call — will include that in the RFC. Scheduling the spike for tomorrow.
